verdict.rationale: Oneleet is a compliance automation platform, so a per-framework readiness view is a fair question for it. The pack only shows multi-framework support (SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, etc.) and framework-linked controls being added or removed. Nothing documents a readiness dashboard, passing-versus-open control counts, or a per-framework completion percentage.

support.subject: As an operations lead, a readiness view shows exactly how far I am from audit-ready per framework — passing controls, open gaps, and what's left, as one honest percentage
